name: Recompa

assets.needs: None for itself. It is a launcher/store that finds, installs and updates native Android ports; each port needs its own game data.
assets.notes: Its catalogue (https://recompa.app/index.json, 734 ports) lists six of the other recomps here with their upstream repos and signing keys: Majora ReMasked, Mareshine, Mario Kart DS, Metroid Fusion, Paper Cut and Skies of Arcadia. PokeDaisy is not in it.

settings.summary: Launcher preferences only; no game settings. No adapter.

display: Has a SecondScreenActivity for dual-screen handhelds (not tested).
notes: v0.5.1 released 2026-11-23. Needs REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES/REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES to install and remove ports; it could replace manual updates for the ports above, but an app signed with a different key (Mario Kart DS) still needs an uninstall.
verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs. APK: jadx manifest and prefs names. Web: GitHub API, recompa.app/index.json.
